title: The Dry Paint
scene: At 11:05 AM, the shop sign was found unpainted. Rain halted work on the outdoor banner from 10:50 to 11:20.

suspects.name: Ravi Hale
suspects.testimony: I was painting the banner under the awning at 11:05.
suspects.contradiction: The awning camera shows the banner untouched at 11:05, and wet paint marked Ravi's gloves.

suspects.name: Selma Pike
suspects.testimony: I was sketching the lettering in the office at 11:05.
suspects.alibiProof: Selma's sketch saved at 11:04 with the final lettering.

suspects.name: Theo Lund
suspects.testimony: I was mixing colors in the back room at 11:05.
suspects.alibiProof: The mixing log shows Theo's initials at 11:03 and 11:09.

suspects.name: Uma Reed
suspects.testimony: I was browsing inside at 11:05, waiting out the rain.
suspects.alibiProof: The shop camera shows Uma at 11:02 and 11:11.
